date: early 1524 (not dated on the leaf; among the Milan items of January 1524)
title: A letter in the first person plural, almost all in cipher, on a feigned illness (plausibly Federico II Gonzaga to Baldassarre Castiglione)
correspondents: unknown (plausibly Federico II Gonzaga -> Baldassarre Castiglione at Rome, by the match with Benzoni's account; the leaf names neither)
folio_note: f. 68r: 23 lines almost all in cipher (letters, numerals and signs: 9, 2, crossed 9, 8, x, 7, a crossed double s, a boxed sign), lines 01-02 blotted and partly clear; no heading; no interlinear, marginal or facing decipherment.
status: Bare cipher; same cipher as catalogue 2368 (f. 298r-v of the same volume). Found by paging all 816 images of the volume (Andrew Aymeloglu with Claude Code agents, 15 Nov 2026). Read in part with a key recovered from the three leaves: targets/mantua1524 (issue #697); 55% of its cipher words read by the project's count. Not on DECODE (decode_search.py: 0 records for 'Vat. lat. 8214', 'Castiglione').
why: Federico II's own account of the urine deception of 1524 told by Benzoni (DBI 45), in cipher; the one leaf whose content has an outside witness, so it can test the key.
score_note: Scored from the DigiVatLib images viewed during the Mantua 1524 work, 15 Nov 2026 (research/sweep_2026-11-16_vat_lat_8214/); the reading is in targets/mantua1524

title: Capino de Capo -> Federico II Gonzaga, extract of a letter from Robbio, two cipher lines on the retreat of the army
correspondents: Capino de Capo -> Federico II Gonzaga, marquis of Mantua (extract)
folio_note: f. 198r: extract headed 'Ex litteris D. Cappini dat. in Robio 8 Aprilis 1524', 26 lines of clear Italian with two cipher lines (17-18, 13 cipher runs, about 66 signs); no decipherment on the leaf.
status: Bare cipher in clear context; same cipher as catalogue 2368 (f. 298r-v of the same volume). why: A short cipher passage on the imperial army's planned withdrawal to Pavia, Cremona and Milan in April 1524, 'secondo dice Barbon'.
